name: Antayoshti Sahayata Yojana
benefit: The scheme provides ₹ 10,000/- for the last rites in the case of the death of the registered beneficiary.
_eligibility_text:
1. The deceased should have been a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The deceased should have been a worker registered with the 'Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board)'.
1. The deceased should have been between 18-60 years of age.
1. The deceased should have been engaged in construction work such as masons, carpenters, electricians, porters, painters, etc.
